name: focusguard
description: Desktop focus guard: a Nemotron agent judges every window you switch to and pulls you back when you drift.

scripts.package:mac: npm run build && electron-packager . FocusGuard --out=release --overwrite --icon=build/icon.icns --app-bundle-id=com.focusguard.app --extend-info=build/Info.extend.plist --ignore=^/server --ignore=^/src --ignore=^/scripts --ignore=^/release --no-asar && codesign --force --deep --sign - release/FocusGuard-darwin-*/FocusGuard.app && echo '\nBuilt: '$(ls -d release/FocusGuard-darwin-*/FocusGuard.app)
